title: Tiki-Taka - All Flow, No Goals in the Browser
author: redwurm

comments.author: redwurm
comments.body:
Started this ([**https://**](https://www.linkedin.com/safety/go/?url=https%3A%2F%2Flnkd%2Ein%2Fet__f3FV&urlhash=ZETi&mt=afcDzoFIseFqeYEqEIWZ2vX1yP59O9zTpiyUVi4GMLwadc9Bc7vf2FA8x-lTemfTVtGlINn7pcAYgHdS1P7hOLnqwh7wVOdo7-Jk80CkhScS5DnYo9hT1S56nQ&isSdui=true)tiki-taka.chris.guru) a few years ago in Vanilla JS and Canvas 2D to get my development skills back up to par but ended up getting distracted with other projects.  
  
I recently ran the new Coding/PM Harness im building through its paces finishing this up with a Combo of Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Qwen 3.8 27b and am pretty happy with the results.  
  
Check it out and see if you can beat my high scores! Highly recommend using a gamepad for the full experience but it does have touch enabled and dynamic views for landscape and portrait on mobile.
